steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates said Argenica Therapeutics was developing a drug candidate to protect brain cells during a stroke, aiming to preserve tissue when oxygen is cut off and addressing the time is brain problem in acute stroke care.

episode.title: Uncovered: Protecting brains of stroke patients - Argenica Therapeutics

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?
Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates said Argenica Therapeutics was spun out of research and listed on the ASX in June 2021 to fund development, aiming to progress its drug through phase 1 safety testing, phase 2 effectiveness trials, and larger phase 3 comparative studies.

episode.title: Uncovered: Protecting brains of stroke patients - Argenica Therapeutics
